paite: Huan ka dak a, ngai in mi khat akhut a tehna khau tawi ka mu hi!
heading: Tehna Khau Tawimi Muhna
english: I lifted up my eyes, and saw, and behold, a man with a measuring line in his hand.

paite: Huai lai in ke'n, “Koilam a hoh ding?" ka chi hi. Ama'n ka kiang ah, "Jerusalem, availam bang tan hi a, adunglam bang tan hiam chih thei ding a teh ding in," ahon chi hi.
english: Then I asked, “Where are you going?” He said to me, “To measure Jerusalem, to see what is its width and what is its length.”

paite: Huan ngai in, kei hon houpih angel apaikhia a, amah kituahpih ding in angel dang khat apaikhe nawn hi.
english: Behold, the angel who talked with me went out, and another angel went out to meet him,

paite: Akiang ah, "Tai inla, huai a tangvalpa kiang ah, Jerusalem zaw asung a mipi tampitak leh ganhonte ziak in, kulhbaang om lou khuate bang in luah in a-om ding a,
english: and said to him, “Run, speak to this young man, saying, ‘Jerusalem will be inhabited as villages without walls, because of the multitude of men and livestock in it.

paite: huan akimvel a meikuang kulhbaang a umtu ka hi ding a, huchi in asung a athupina ka hih ding ziak in, TOUPA'N achi," chi in.
english: For I,’ says Yahweh, ‘will be to her a wall of fire around it, and I will be the glory in the middle of her.

paite: Khai, khai, mallam gam a kipan taikek un, TOUPA'N achi; van huih lite bang in nou lah ka hon dalhzaksakta ngal a, TOUPA'N achi.
heading: TOUPA'N Zion Adeihsakna
english: Come! Come! Flee from the land of the north,’ says Yahweh; ‘for I have spread you abroad as the four winds of the sky,’ says Yahweh.

paite: Khai! Zion ah tai in, nang Babulon tanu toh tengkhawm un.
english: ‘Come, Zion! Escape, you who dwell with the daughter of Babylon.’

paite: Huchibang in sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi, thupina khit in nang hon lok namte kiang ah ama'n kei ahon sawl hi; kuapeuh nang hon khoih in amit nauta khoih ahi.
english: For Yahweh of Armies says: ‘For honor he has sent me to the nations which plundered you; for he who touches you touches the apple of his eye.

paite: "Ngai in, atung ua ka khut sing ding ka hi a, huchi in ana uh sepsakte a ding in gallak ahi ding uh; huan sepaihte TOUPA'N kei ahon sawl chih na thei ding uh.
english: For, behold, I will shake my hand over them, and they will be a plunder to those who served them; and you will know that Yahweh of Armies has sent me.

paite: "Aw Zion tanu, la sa inla, kipak in; ngai in, kei na lak ua teng ding in ka hong pai hi," TOUPA'N achi.
english: Sing and rejoice, daughter of Zion! For behold, I come and I will dwell within you,’ says Yahweh.

paite: Huai ni chiang in TOUPA lam ah nam tampi akizomkhawm ding ua, ka mite ahi ding uh; na lak ah ka teng ding a, huchi in sepaihte' TOUPA'N na kiang ah kei ahon sawl chih na thei ding hi.
english: Many nations shall join themselves to Yahweh in that day, and shall be my people; and I will dwell among you, and you shall know that Yahweh of Armies has sent me to you.

paite: Huan gam siangthou a atantuam bang in TOUPA'N Judah aluah ding a, Jerusalem ahon tel ding hi.
english: Yahweh will inherit Judah as his portion in the holy land, and will again choose Jerusalem.

paite: Dai un, mi tengteng, TOUPA ma ah a-omna siangthou a kipan in amah akhanglou in athoukheta hi.
english: Be silent, all flesh, before Yahweh; for he has roused himself from his holy habitation!”
